payload.name: Information Scent in Visual Search
payload.fact: Strong, unambiguous information scent cues guide users toward more linear and efficient navigation paths, while weak or conflicting cues lead to randomization and increased cognitive load.
payload.boundary: Visual search in hyperbolic tree browsers

provenance.title: 24 THE PURSUIT OF EFFICIENT SEARCHING: A STUDY ON STUDENTS’ INFORMATION FORAGING PATH SELECTION AND COGNITIVE LOAD IN DIGITAL LIBRARY ENVIRONMENTS
provenance.quote_or_locus: Strong, unambiguous information scent cues significantly guided users toward more linear and efficient navigation paths, resulting in higher task completion accuracy. (2) In contrast, weak or conflicting scent cues led to significant randomization in path selection, characterized by backtracking and exploratory loops, which was consistently accompanied by a marked increase in subjective and objective cognitive load

provenance.title: The effects of information scent on visual search in the hyperbolic tree browser
provenance.quote_or_locus: Two processes appear to affect visual search in the Hyperbolic display: strong information scent improves visual search, and the crowding of targets in a compressed region degrades visual search especially when there is weak information scent
